args.description: Multiple suspicious tools for network reconnaissance and packet analysis are installed on the system: (1) Ethereal v0.10.6 (packet sniffer/network analyzer) - execution confirmed at 2004-08-27 15:34:54 via prefetch; (2) Look@LAN (LAN scanning tool) - found in Program Files; (3) Whois tool installed in Program Files; (4) nmap source code and tools found in My Documents\\FOOTPRINTING\\NT\\Nmapnt directory; (5) libpcap library (packet capture library) found alongside nmap; (6) CAIN.EXE (password sniffing/network analysis tool) - execution confirmed at 2004-08-27 15:33:03 via prefetch. CRITICAL NOTE: MFT shows some Ethereal files dated 2004-08-09, but Windows was installed 2004-08-19. Installers (ethereal-setup-0.10.6.exe, WinPcap_3_01_a.exe, lalsetup250.exe) found on Desktop dated 2004-08-27 15:14-15:28, just before execution and imaging. This indicates tools were downloaded/re-installed immediately before evidence collection, not pre-positioned from Aug 9. The earlier Aug 9 dates require forensic clarification (possible timestamp manipulation or file dating issue).
